name: deep-clone
description: Implement a deep clone function that handles nested objects, arrays, dates, and circular references

promptLevels.beginner: create a function to deep clone objects
promptLevels.intermediate: implement a deepClone function that copies nested objects and arrays
promptLevels.advanced: create a deepClone function that handles objects, arrays, Date objects, and avoids infinite loops with circular references
promptLevels.expert: Implement a `deepClone<T>(obj: T): T` function that creates a deep copy of any value. Handle: primitive values, plain objects, arrays, Date objects, Map, Set, and circular references (objects referencing themselves). {languageSpecific}

languageInstructions.typescript: Use TypeScript with generics for type preservation. Export only the deepClone function.
languageInstructions.javascript: Use JavaScript. Use a WeakMap to track circular references. Export only the deepClone function.
languageInstructions.javascript-jsdoc: Use JavaScript with JSDoc annotations including @template for generics. Export only the deepClone function.

variants.typescript: Implement a `deepClone<T>(obj: T): T` function in TypeScript. Handle: primitives, plain objects, arrays, Date, Map, Set, and circular references using a WeakMap. Export only the deepClone function.
variants.javascript: Implement a `deepClone(obj)` function in JavaScript. Handle: primitives, plain objects, arrays, Date, Map, Set, and circular references using a WeakMap. Export only the deepClone function.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Implement a `deepClone(obj)` function in JavaScript with full JSDoc including @template T annotation. Handle all cases mentioned. Export only the deepClone function.

testCases.test: const obj = {a: 1, b: {c: 2}}; const clone = deepClone(obj); clone.b.c = 99; console.assert(obj.b.c === 2, 'Original should be unchanged');
const arr = [1, [2, [3]]]; const clone = deepClone(arr); clone[1][1][0] = 99; console.assert(arr[1][1][0] === 3, 'Nested arrays should be cloned');
const date = new Date('2023-01-01'); const clone = deepClone({d: date}); console.assert(clone.d instanceof Date && clone.d.getTime() === date.getTime(), 'Dates should be cloned');
const obj = {a: 1}; obj.self = obj; const clone = deepClone(obj); console.assert(clone.self === clone && clone !== obj, 'Circular refs should work');
